description: This file defines a CMake module containing a function 'compile_aidl' that automates the process of generating source code from AIDL files during build time. It specifies how to find the aidl compiler, prepare parameters, and execute the command to generate language-specific source files and headers.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines and executes a build function to compile AIDL files into source code, supporting parameters for compiler location, language, include directories, flags, and target directory.
